First session of the Post Quantum transaction signature (PQTS) Breakout Room

# Agenda overview

This inaugural call focuses on high-level overviews, expectation setting, and community alignment for the Post Quantum transaction signature (PQTS).

**Agenda**:

* Introduction to PQTS and its goals
* Walk-through of the [current](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8051) [EIPs](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8052) 
* [New AA](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-8141) and long term vision
* [Zero-Knowledge proof of seed as a graceful emergency fallback](https://ethresear.ch/t/how-to-hard-fork-to-save-most-users-funds-in-a-quantum-emergency/18901)  
* [Cryptographic Agility](https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1889#issuecomment-3786344321)
